narr: Thunderstorms occurred in mid July with monsoonal flow. A few thunderstorms produced very heavy rainfall on July 14.
ev: Calle de Los Campesinos road was partially washed out. 1 inch of rain and large hail occurred in about 60 minutes. This location is just west of State Route 74 in Palm Desert.
lsr: Calle de Los Campesinos road was washed out partially. This road runs along the foothills. Thunderstorms produced very heavy rainfall.
